stem: The mass of a pesticide on a tea leaf at a plantation near Sylhet, Bangladesh, is measured after the pesticide is sprayed. The mass, in micrograms, \(d\) days after spraying is modeled by \(M(d) = 800\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{d}{5}}\). According to the model, after how many days is the mass of the pesticide on the leaf equal to 100 micrograms?
solution: Check: the mass halves every 5 days, and three halvings take \(800 \to 400 \to 200 \to 100\) in 15 days.
verify:
d = symbols('d', real=True)
sol = solve(Eq(800*Rational(1, 2)**(d/5), 100), d)
assert sol == [15]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 15
